name: BeWise: Daily Wisdom Quotes
subtitle: One beautiful quote each day
promotionalText: Take ten seconds each morning for one good thought. Free, no account, no ads.
description:
BeWise brings you one beautiful quote every morning, set on a full-screen photograph. Take ten seconds, read it, and carry one good thought through your day.

• A new quote every day, from more than 1,100 hand-picked quotes
• 9 themes: Inspiration, Leadership, Life, Love, Humour, Art, Sports, Students and Programming
• In your language: BeWise follows your phone and translates every quote
• Share any quote as a ready-to-post image card
• A gentle daily reminder at the time you choose
• Browse every past quote in the archive
• Home screen and lock screen widgets with today’s quote and photo
• Free. No account. No ads. No tracking.

BeWise is open source and built with Capacitor by the Capgo team.
whatsNew:
BeWise 3.0 is a complete rebuild:
• Ready for iPhone Duo, folded and open
• Now in your language: BeWise follows your phone and translates every quote
• Quote of the day widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen
• A fresh quote every morning, on a beautiful photo
• New design with a native tab bar and smooth transitions
• Share quotes as image cards and get a daily reminder
